profile.name: Neha Mayacharya
profile.tagline: Perception, powered by design + AI — Designing the intelligent interface.
profile.bio: I design experiences at the intersection of intelligent systems and spatial computing — intuitive, empathetic, and technically grounded. Over five years, I've delivered 20+ digital products across healthcare, enterprise, and education — from AI-driven dashboards and conversational interfaces to immersive VR therapy programs and luxury metaverse retail. I move fluidly between 2D UX and 3D interaction design, between research insight and shipped product. Currently completing an Executive Master's in Artificial Intelligence (GPA 4.0), sharpening the bridge between design craft and machine intelligence. Authorized to work in the U.S. on STEM OPT.
profile.availability: Available 2026 · STEM OPT · Open to roles & collaborations

projects.title: VisaGenie: AI-Powered Transparency for Global Migration
projects.subtitle: AI · Transparency
projects.blurb: AI-powered transparency platform that simplifies complex global immigration workflows through intelligent UX and conversational interfaces.
projects.description: AI-powered transparency platform that simplifies complex global immigration workflows through intelligent UX and conversational interfaces.

details.challenge: Global immigration is opaque — fragmented rules, forms, and timelines create anxiety and errors.
details.approach: Designed an intelligent UX layer with conversational guidance that translates complex visa logic into clear, stepwise transparency. Anchored to verified sources.
